title: Unboxed Modpack
description: An SMP Modpack that revolves around keeping Minecraft entertaining in a vanilla style - Containing popular 1.21.1 Mods!
body:
## 🗓️ About This Modpack
This modpack enhances the core vanilla Minecraft experience with a carefully chosen set of lightweight, exploration- and building-oriented mods. Designed with multiplayer compatibility and ease of use in mind, it provides quality-of-life improvements and gameplay depth without straying from the spirit of vanilla.

Originally created for a private server, this pack is now available to anyone looking for a smooth, exploration-friendly multiplayer experience. If you'd like to join the community and play on the server yourself, you're welcome—join the Discord here!

## 🌍 Key Features:
- Tectonic: overhauls terrain while keeping the vanilla biome identity intact
- Backpacks: adds useful storage without breaking balance
- Trowel: randomized block placement from your hotbar—perfect for detailed builds
- Carry On: pick up chests, mobs, and blocks with ease
- Netherite Tool Trims: extends tool progression in a subtle, lore-friendly way

## 🎯 Why This Modpack?
- Feels like vanilla+, not a completely new game
- Lightweight and easy to run
- No complex tech mods or overwhelming systems
- Built for exploration, creativity, and co-op
- Pre-configured for seamless multiplayer—no mod mismatch issues

Whether you're adventuring solo or building with friends, this modpack keeps Minecraft's core gameplay intact just better, smoother, and more fun. Give it a try, or hop on the server and join the growing community!

Have mod suggestions or feedback? Drop them in the Discord — we’re building this together!
